combo_label: Time & Clocks × Horses & Riding × Robin Hood

entries.clue: Hair along the top of the neck, plaited into bobbles before a show
Dark, poisonous churchyard evergreen whose springy wood armed English archers
A span of ten summers: the sixties, say, or the nineties
Beggar's rags or a potter's cart, put on to walk into Nottingham unrecognised
Arrow case worn at the archer's belt; also, to shake with fear
The gold at dead centre of the mark, where Robin split his rival's shaft
Monday to Sunday inclusive, then you do the whole thing again
Equestrian triathlon: an arena test, then cross-country, then coloured poles
Belly strap that stops the saddle slipping; elsewhere, a waistline measurement
January to December: one lap of the sun, taking 365 days and a quarter
Twelve at night, when one day quietly hands over to the next
